content.text: /ext:medcp How many children under 18 have an asthma diagnosis in our system?

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code, invalid_reason
FROM omop.concept
WHERE lower(concept_name) = 'asthma'
   OR lower(concept_name) LIKE 'asthma%'
ORDER BY CASE WHEN lower(concept_name)='asthma' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, standard_concept DESC NULLS LAST, concept_id
LIMIT 20

arguments.sql_query:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.person_id) AS children_under_18_with_asthma
FROM omop.person p
JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
  ON co.person_id = p.person_id
JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca
  ON ca.descendant_concept_id = co.condition_concept_id
WHERE ca.ancestor_concept_id = 317009
  AND (
    DATEDIFF(year, COALESCE(p.birth_datetime, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, COALESCE(p.month_of_birth, 1), COALESCE(p.day_of_birth, 1))), CAST(GETDATE() AS date))
    - CASE WHEN DATEADD(year, DATEDIFF(year, COALESCE(p.birth_datetime, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, COALESCE(p.month_of_birth, 1), COALESCE(p.day_of_birth, 1))), CAST(GETDATE() AS date)), COALESCE(p.birth_datetime, DATEFROMPARTS(p.year_of_birth, COALESCE(p.month_of_birth, 1), COALESCE(p.day_of_birth, 1)))) > CAST(GETDATE() AS date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) < 18

content.text:
39,390 children under 18 have an asthma diagnosis in the OMOP EHR system.

I counted distinct `person_id`s with a `condition_occurrence` under the standard SNOMED Asthma concept (`concept_id = 317009`) and current age `< 18`.
